title: Template Content QA for Real User Trial
completionDefinition: Phase 8D added template content QA, trial template selection, trial content readiness, content QA fixtures, and administrator panels.

8D did not implement production app, backend, database, accounts, analytics, AI generation, OpenAI/external API usage, camera, AR, training, App Store/TestFlight, online publication, service worker, offline cache, push notification, background sync, install tracking, new runtime dependencies, or real user data collection.

8D did not collect real names, contact information, photos, health information, sensitive identity information, face embeddings, biometric identifiers, backend records, analytics records, or training data.
Makeup Engine remains the template production system and UserAppTemplatePackage remains the handoff contract.
Docs and project-state must remain recoverable and validation commands must pass.
